name: Ailuran
desc: Ailurans are lean, digitigrade feline humanoids, 1.6 to 1.9 meters tall, covered in short dense fur from charcoal to silver-gray. Vertical-slit pupils, four-fingered hands with retractable claws, a prehensile tail. They are completely colorblind but perceive thermal radiation and bio-electric fields as luminous auras. Hidden in the margins for ages, they stepped into galactic view only after the Veil Rip dissolved their concealment infrastructure.

gifts.name: Achromatic Aura-Sight
gifts.text: Your eyes perceive thermal radiation and bio-electric fields rather than visible light. You see perfectly in total darkness out to Far range, reading the world as overlapping auras. You can detect living creatures behind thin barriers within Close range by thermal signature. You are completely colorblind: checks relying exclusively on color identification are at Disadvantage unless you use assistive tech. Creatures with no thermal output (some Synthetics, dormant Bloomstriders) appear as cold silhouettes.

gifts.name: Perfect Equilibrium
gifts.text: Your digitigrade legs, prehensile tail, and predatory reflexes grant supernatural balance and climbing ability. You are immune to fall damage from medium heights (roughly two stories or less). You gain Advantage on all Agility rolls to balance, climb, or move silently across unstable or narrow surfaces. You can scale vertical surfaces with even minimal handholds without rolling, provided you are not in combat or under immediate time pressure.

extra.name: Irrepressible Curiosity
extra.text: Discovery is a biological imperative for you, not a hobby. When hidden information exists that you could plausibly discover, the Keeper may invoke this Gift. You then face a choice: mark 1 Stress to resist the compulsion and walk away, or yield on your own terms and pursue the secret. If you yield and successfully uncover the hidden truth, the Keeper grants you 1 path resource: 1 Hope if you are Awakened, or 1 Effort if you are Sleeping.

subStrains.name: Shroud-Strain
subStrains.flavor: Sleeker, lightly built, with chromatophore fur that shifts in real time. Patient to the point of unsettling stillness, capable of waiting hours without moving a muscle.
subStrains.featText: Your chromatophore fur provides active camouflage. As long as you remain completely motionless — no movement, speech, or active equipment use — you are effectively invisible to both visual and thermal detection. Creatures attempting to detect you must succeed on an Instinct check against DC 16. The effect ends immediately if you move, speak, attack, or take any action; reassuming stillness requires spending a full turn doing nothing. This is biological camouflage, not technology — it cannot be jammed.

subStrains.name: Surge-Strain
subStrains.flavor: Heavier, more powerfully muscled, frames built for explosive acceleration. Their leg musculature is visibly denser, packed with fast-twitch fibers.
subStrains.featText: Your metabolism can store and release kinetic energy in controlled bursts. Once per scene, mark 1 Stress to activate a Metabolic Burst: you move instantly to any point within Far range that you can see, ignoring difficult terrain and obstacles shorter than your height. This movement does not provoke reactions. Upon arriving, you gain Advantage on your next Agility or Finesse roll made before the end of your next turn. Observers see a blur of fur and feel a displacement of air.

complications.name: Compulsive Fixation
complications.text: A detail catches your attention at the worst possible moment. You hesitate, distracted; the Keeper narrates what you miss.

complications.name: Thermal Misread
complications.text: Your aura-sight interprets a signature incorrectly. You misidentify a threat level, an emotional state, or the number of creatures nearby.

complications.name: Exposed Position
complications.text: Your need to get closer, to see more, to know, puts you somewhere you should not be. The Keeper places you in a compromised position.

complications.name: Broken Silence
complications.text: Your investigation makes noise, leaves evidence, or triggers an alarm you did not anticipate. Someone now knows you were here.

complications.name: Information Debt
complications.text: You owe someone a secret you do not yet have. An old contract comes due at the worst time.

complications.name: The Itch That Won't Stop
complications.text: The compulsion spikes hard. Mark 1 Stress. Your hands shake. Your focus narrows. You need to know, now.

name: Bloomstrider
desc: Bloomstriders are children of living planets, fused animal and plant. Skin like tree bark shifts brown to green to gold with mood and season; glowing sap pulses through visible veins. Hair is living moss, ferns, or vines; some bear flowers, leaves, thorns, or ridges. Deep eyes with pupils that open like blooming flowers. They live as gardeners to the places they inhabit, viewing the Great Silence as a chance for new growth.

gifts.name: Plant-like Body
gifts.text: Your body can survive in harsh environments, granting resistance to natural dangers including poisons, vacuum, extreme weather, radiation, and hunger. You can derive energy from light like a plant, and special organs filter toxins from your system. Gain Advantage on survival checks in hostile environments.

gifts.name: Nurturing Touch
gifts.text: You can use your healing sap to mend wounds. By touching another creature, you initiate a healing-over-time effect: the target heals 1 HP at the start of each of their turns for 1d4 turns. The healing requires several minutes of focused contact to begin and represents the gradual binding of flesh and bone by your luminous sap. Faint, root-like patterns appear on the healed skin, fading after a short time.

complications.name: Sap-Bleed
complications.text: Your luminous sap leaks visibly. You are easier to track or detect until you can recover.

complications.name: Rootshock
complications.text: A sudden wave of empathic feedback overwhelms you. Mark 1 Stress.

complications.name: Symbiotic Overgrowth
complications.text: Vines, spores, or fronds react uncontrollably, entangling gear or slowing movement.

complications.name: Echo of Decay
complications.text: You sense hidden corruption or infestation nearby; the Keeper introduces a new complication.

complications.name: Hungry Symbiosis
complications.text: You must consume scarce resources (biomass, nutrients) or take 1 Stress.

complications.name: Pollen Bloom
complications.text: You release spores that alter the social atmosphere, helpful to some, alarming to others.

name: Celestiari
desc: Celestiari are beings of pure celestial energy given form, bodies carved from living starlight, skin glowing with soft inner radiance that shifts like aurora. Tall and graceful, with proportions embodying cosmic harmony. Eyes like twin stars; hair like cascading energy. Voices carry the music of the spheres. Ageless and effectively immortal — guardians who have watched over the galaxy since the dawn of time, protectors of the innocent.

gifts.name: Stellar Meditation
gifts.text: An old meditative discipline lets you steady yourself in quiet light. Once per long rest, you may meditate for 10 minutes under starlight (or any light source) to clear 1 Stress and gain 2 path resources: 2 Hope if you are Awakened, or 2 Effort if you are Sleeping.

gifts.name: Celestial Grace
gifts.text: Your stellar nature infuses your very being with cosmic power. Your unarmed attacks deal d6 magic damage instead of normal damage, as your touch carries the power of starfire. Once per session, when you deal damage that causes HP loss with this ability, you may heal the same amount of damage to any allies within Very Close range, sharing your celestial energy with those in need.

complications.name: Blinding Flare
complications.text: Your glow surges uncontrollably, dazzling allies or exposing your position.

complications.name: Resonant Disruption
complications.text: Your aura interferes with nearby technology.

complications.name: Emotional Backlash
complications.text: Empathic resonance overwhelms you; mark 1 Stress.

complications.name: Fractured Halo
complications.text: Your light flickers, sowing unease.

complications.name: Attractive Beacon
complications.text: Enemies or desperate refugees are drawn to you.

complications.name: Radiant Fatigue
complications.text: Your brilliance wanes; Disadvantage on your next roll.

name: Ethereal
desc: Ethereals are caught between states of existence — translucent, shifting, constantly phasing in and out of solidity. Made of crystallized starlight and shadow, flickering between matter and energy. Features hauntingly beautiful but never stable: violet eyes shift to silver, hair flows like mercury, skin shimmers with nebular patterns. No fixed gender or age. When they move, they leave afterimages of paths not taken.

gifts.name: Phase Shift
gifts.text: Ethereals can step outside the normal flow of reality. You may mark 1 Stress to become incorporeal. You remain incorporeal as long as you continue to mark 1 Stress at the start of each of your turns. While incorporeal, you can pass through solid objects thinner than your body width and not protected by energy (energy fields, wards, force barriers block this ability). You are immune to physical attacks while incorporeal but cannot affect the physical world.

gifts.name: Temporal Perception
gifts.text: Your existence spans multiple timelines, giving you glimpses of possible futures. You automatically sense temporal anomalies and distortions within Close range. Once per session, you may ask the Keeper about the most likely immediate consequence of a proposed action.

complications.name: Time Stutter
complications.text: You skip a moment; the Keeper narrates what you 'miss.'

complications.name: Echoed Actions
complications.text: You act twice in slightly different ways; the Keeper chooses the worse.

complications.name: Premonition Paralysis
complications.text: A vision of failure freezes you; Disadvantage on your next roll.

complications.name: Temporal Strain
complications.text: The effort fractures your composure; mark 1 Stress.

complications.name: Continuity Drift
complications.text: An NPC reacts as though you've already acted.

complications.name: Future Shadow
complications.text: You glimpse a looming threat; the Keeper foreshadows new danger.

name: Human
desc: Humanity is a kaleidoscope of physical forms — there is no single 'human' look. Skin from void-dark to pale-frozen-moon. Hair in any color. From gene-sculpted Core World elites to hard-bitten void-miners of the Rim, their appearance is as varied as the stars. No defining feature, no natural armor, no ethereal grace. Their biology is a blank slate, adaptable and versatile. Lifespans, once centuries long, are now as unpredictable as a Veil storm.

gifts.name: Adaptive Spirit
gifts.text: Humanity's greatest asset is its refusal to stay down. Once per game session, when you fail an action roll, you may spend 2 Hope to gain Advantage on your next roll of the same type. The mechanic represents the human pattern of turning a failure into the lesson that drives the next attempt.

gifts.name: Cultural Bridge
gifts.text: Humans are found everywhere and have learned to read the motivations and customs of many other species. During a rest, you can mark 1 Stress to represent the mental effort of sorting through cultural knowledge. You may then ask the Keeper one question about a specific group's core motivations or most important customs. The Keeper answers truthfully.

complications.name: Overreach
complications.text: You succeed, but attract more danger than expected.

complications.name: Burnout
complications.text: You push beyond safe limits; mark 1 Stress.

complications.name: Fractured Unity
complications.text: Your choices spark division among allies or NPCs.

complications.name: Collateral Damage
complications.text: Your improvisation causes unintended harm or loss of resources.

complications.name: Haunted Past
complications.text: Memories of Earth or exile distract you, costing tempo.

complications.name: Resource Drain
complications.text: Supplies run dry faster than planned; the Keeper removes or reduces a resource.

name: Kryllian
desc: Kryllians are insectoid humanoids from high-gravity worlds — willowy but extraordinarily robust, with dense chitinous exoskeletons as natural armor. Four arms: two larger upper for combat and lifting, two smaller lower for fine manipulation. A Kryllian mechanic can simultaneously weld a plate, tighten a bolt, consult a schematic, and hold a light. Compound eyes grant wide vision and perceive details invisible to others. Lifespans exceed three centuries.

gifts.name: Master Craftsman
gifts.text: The Kryllian mind is uniquely suited for building and repairing. When making any roll related to crafting or repairing a piece of technology, you may choose to mark 1 Stress to gain Advantage on the roll. This represents a flash of insight or a moment of intense focus.

gifts.name: Structural Intuition
gifts.text: Kryllians see the weak points in any construction. Once per game session, you may mark 1 Stress to study a technological system or structure. You can then ask the Keeper about its single most significant structural or systemic weakness. The Keeper answers truthfully.

complications.name: Hive Echo
complications.text: Phantom brood voices overwhelm you; hesitation costs tempo.

complications.name: Exoshell Stress
complications.text: Your carapace cracks; reduce defense until repaired.

complications.name: Instinctive Panic
complications.text: Old predator instincts flare, startling allies or escalating conflict.

complications.name: Pheromone Spill
complications.text: You release signals unintentionally; others detect or track you.

complications.name: Ancestral Weight
complications.text: Hive-memory burdens you with trauma; mark 1 Stress.

complications.name: Broodmark
complications.text: You shed fragments or molt, leaving traces behind.

name: Kryx
desc: Tall, broad-shouldered, powerfully built, the Kryx resemble wolves given humanoid form and intelligence. Thick fur from shadowsteel to pale ash, patterns unique to each individual and family. Their striking feature: bioluminescent ridges along spine and limbs, pulsing brighter with emotion — a living beacon of rage, loyalty, or triumph. Feral eyes; retractable claws; powerful jaws. Lifespan: eighty years; most in constant conflict see less.

gifts.name: Pack Intuition
gifts.text: Your bond with your companions allows you to sense threats to them before they fully manifest. When an ally within Very Close range is targeted by an attack, you may mark 1 Stress to gain Advantage on your next attack against that foe. This represents the surge of protective fury that fills you when your pack is threatened.

gifts.name: Biolume Howl
gifts.text: Your natural weapons carry the power of your pack's collective strength. Your unarmed attacks deal d6 void damage instead of normal damage. Once per session, you may mark 1 Stress when making an unarmed attack to make your target Dazed (Disadvantage on their next roll) and gain 1 path resource (Hope if Awakened, Effort progress if Sleeping) as your pack bond strengthens through combat.

complications.name: Predator's Lunge
complications.text: You overcommit to aggression; the Keeper escalates the threat.

complications.name: Instinctive Shift
complications.text: Your body adapts reflexively in an unhelpful way.

complications.name: Cold-Blooded Hesitation
complications.text: Environmental stress slows your reactions; Disadvantage on your next roll.

complications.name: Territorial Snarl
complications.text: You react possessively, sparking tension with allies.

complications.name: Hunger Spike
complications.text: Your metabolism surges; mark 1 Stress.

complications.name: Primal Fright
complications.text: A survival reflex makes you falter or briefly retreat.

name: Rift Spinner
desc: Rift Spinners are beings of crystalline beauty and arachnid grace. Bodies of bio-crystalline material like living diamond, refracting light in spectacular patterns. Tall and slender, with eight limbs that function as arms or legs. Movements fluid and precise. Faces hauntingly beautiful, with large complex eyes that hold the wisdom of ages. Bioluminescence flows beneath crystalline skin, pulsing with thoughts and emotions. Lifespans measured in millennia.

gifts.name: Chrono-Gift
gifts.text: Your connection to temporal energy allows you to manipulate the flow of time in small ways. Once per session, after any roll is made within Close range (including your own), you may spend 2 path resources (2 Hope if you are Awakened, or 2 Effort if you are Sleeping) to force a reroll. You can choose to use either result.

gifts.name: Wall Weaver
gifts.text: Your arachnid heritage allows you to move on any surface with perfect grace. You can move on vertical or inverted surfaces as if they were normal ground. While touching a surface, you can sense vibrations through it, gaining Advantage on Perception checks to detect moving creatures within Close range that are also in contact with the surface.

complications.name: Thread Snap
complications.text: A rift collapses, stranding or displacing something important.

complications.name: Spatial Whiplash
complications.text: Your body reels from distortion; mark 1 Stress.

complications.name: Echo Warp
complications.text: Sound or vision repeats unnaturally, causing confusion.

complications.name: Unstable Weave
complications.text: A tear destabilizes the environment; the Keeper introduces a hazard.

complications.name: Entangled Step
complications.text: You flicker into a new position, dropping or losing an item.

complications.name: Resonant Collapse
complications.text: The Veil hums with backlash; nearby tech glitches or fails.

name: Synthetic
desc: Synthetics come in a bewildering variety of forms reflecting the purposes for which they were created. Some are nearly indistinguishable from their creators with synthetic skin and eyes. Others are clearly artificial — bodies of metal, plastic, exotic materials. Some humanoid with subtle tells; others exotic, with multiple limbs, modular components, or environment-specific bodies. What unites them is not appearance but the spark of self-awareness.

gifts.name: Modular Consciousness
gifts.text: Your artificial mind can be temporarily boosted with new capabilities. Once per long rest, you can download a new skill or knowledge set. Choose any Trait; you can spend Hope to gain Advantage on rolls using that Trait until your next long rest.

gifts.name: Digital Interface
gifts.text: Your synthetic nature allows you to directly interface with electronic systems and networks. You have Advantage on rolls to hack, operate, or understand technological devices. You can also communicate directly with other AIs and computer systems, bypassing normal user interfaces.

complications.name: Sensor Glitch
complications.text: A sensory subsystem misfires for an instant. Vision flickers, audio cuts to static, proprioception drifts. You miss something obvious or react to something that is not there.

complications.name: Recursive Loop
complications.text: A decision process enters a brief loop. You hesitate at the threshold of action. The Keeper takes Spotlight away from you for the round.

complications.name: Unwanted Retrieval
complications.text: A buried memory surfaces: an old purpose, a former owner's voice, a moment of pre-consciousness operation. Mark 1 Stress; the rest of the scene runs with the memory at the edge of your processing.

complications.name: Thermal Bloom
complications.text: Hardware strain produces a perceivable signature: heat shimmer, an audible whine, a brief charge in the air around you. Anyone watching for non-organic markers gets a clean read.

complications.name: Children/Seekers Echo
complications.text: Your underlying architecture briefly asserts itself against your chosen identity. You act, for one beat, in your original programmed pattern. You may spend 1 Hope to refuse, but the refusal is visible.

complications.name: Recognized Mark
complications.text: Someone in the scene identifies your serial number, manufacturer's mark, or a distinguishing modification. The recognition is not friendly.
